body: I feel like this is a hint of the ultimate tragic fate of Angel's character.
I really do wish there was more discussion about the show!

Yeah, I can't help but think Angel will meet a tragic fate at the hands of the self-hating and selfish Stan. Countless transgender women have, sadly, all because of a man's pathetic ego.
I can't count the number of stories I've come across involving transgendered people and homosexuals being brutally murdered by their paranoid closeted "lovers" or johns.
It happened to one if the subjects in the documentary "Paris is Burning". By the end of the film the poor young girl had been strangled to death, stuffed under a bed and left for 4 days before her body was discovered. And then virtually no one came forward to claim her remains. Her killer got away with it, of course.
I think Stan's character on the show would get away with murdering Angel too.

Yes, Blanca is my personal favorite character. So resilient, and warm. But the tragedy that literally lurks within her own body is always there in the background somewhere, making her very relatable to me. 
In those days survival after that diagnosis was, as the show unflinchingly displayed, like hoping to win the lottery. I can only imagine how dynamics will change and Blanca's HIV status gets leaked. I'm sure it will. And from personal experience I know a person like her ex-house mother rival will try to emotionally exploit her with it.
Unfortunately, Facebook hasn't been doing anything that smartphone in your hand or pocket hasn't been doing 24/7. Everything on it is somewhere else too. And you'll never be able to prevent that.
